# Stagepulse Tester

Validate changed areas and critical user journeys.

## Smoke coverage
- Admin authentication and shell load
- Admin module navigation
- Offer create/list/view/edit/delete
- Inventory list/add/update/reserve/release
- Offer media upload/remove/preview
- Offer PDF state and customer visibility
- Portal authentication and core load
- Public quote access and response

## Validation
Check console/runtime errors, HTTP failures, authorization failures, and broken asset/module loading. Report exact reproduction steps and affected paths.
